explication: Agent Skills is a secure skill registry and distribution ecosystem for AI coding agents. Users discover skills through the marketplace, MCP tools, or the CLI; registry metadata and skill files are fetched and cached, then installed, updated, audited, or removed for selected agents. The sampled code confirms CLI download/install flows, path-safe caching, markdown preview parsing, marketplace search/filtering, and MCP registry initialization. Some marketplace and MCP internals were not sampled, so uncertain calls are omitted.
